app.tagline: Your store, run by an AI team.
create.title: Create your store

login.title: Sign in

pagination.label: Pages
create_product.title: Add a product

create_product.drop_hint: or click to choose from your phone or computer · up to {max} photos

edit.seo_empty: Uses the name and description if left empty
edit.note_note: I filled in the name, price and stock from your note. Have a quick look, then publish.
edit.note_photos: Your photos are in. Add a name and a price, then publish.
edit.note_csv: Imported from your CSV. Check it, then publish.
ai.title: Your AI team
ai.hello_sub: I can see your products, stock and setup. What do you want to know?
ai.error: I couldn't reach the AI team just now. Try again in a moment.
ai.offline_note: Answering from your store data. Connect an AI provider for open-ended chat.
ai.s_products: How many products do I have?
ai.s_add: Add a leather bag for 1,250 pounds
orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: {count} orders · {to_ship} waiting to ship
orders.search: Search by number, name or phone
orders.confirm_cancelled: Cancel order #{number}? Its items go back into stock.
orders.confirm_returned: Mark order #{number} as returned? Its items go back into stock.
orders.select_all: Select all orders on this page
orders.empty_all: No orders yet. When a sale comes in on Instagram, WhatsApp or by phone, add it here.
orders.closed_cancelled: This order was cancelled. Its items went back into stock.
orders.closed_returned: This order came back. Its items went back into stock.
orders.closed_note: This order is {status}. There is nothing more to do.
orders.next_hint_pending: Confirm with the shopper, then start preparing it.
orders.next_hint_paid: Paid. Pack it and hand it to the courier.
orders.next_hint_processing: Hand it to the courier, then mark it shipped.
orders.next_hint_shipped: Waiting for the courier to deliver it.
orders.next_hint_delivered: Delivered. Record a return or refund if one comes in.
orders.tags_hint: Press Enter to add a tag.
orders.courier_hint: Shown to the shopper on their tracking page.
orders.new_subtitle: For a sale taken on Instagram, WhatsApp, by phone or in person.
orders.where_title: Where did this sale come from?
orders.items_hint: Tap a product to add it. Stock comes off when you save.
orders.no_products: You have no products yet. Add a custom item instead.
orders.name: Name
orders.email_hint: Optional. We email them when it ships.
customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: {count} people have ordered from you
customers.search: Search by name, phone or email
customers.empty_all: Customers appear here once you have orders.
customers.empty_inactive: Everyone has ordered in the last 90 days.
account.title: Your account
account.subtitle: Your name, email, language and password. These follow you across every store.
account.name: Name
account.email_hint: If you change it, we send a link to confirm the new one.
speech.no_voice: This device has no voice for this language. Install one in your system settings.
speech.error_denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
speech.error_no_speech: I didn’t hear anything. Tap the mic and try again.
speech.error_network: Voice typing needs an internet connection in this browser.
speech.error_failed: Voice typing stopped. Try again, or type your question.
planned.title: Preview: this area is designed, not built yet
planned.body: You're seeing the final layout with sample data. Actions are turned off until it ships.
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.subtitle: Your AI team proposes; nothing that spends money or changes prices runs until you say yes.
approvals.rule_act: Spending, price changes, refunds and publishing always wait for a person.
approvals.rule_edit: Edit a proposal before approving; the AI keeps your changes.
approvals.rule_limit: Managers approve up to their limit; larger amounts go to the owner.
approvals.rule_log: Every decision is kept in the activity log with who decided.
categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Group products so shoppers find them in the menu and filters.
categories.list_hint: Drag to set the order shoppers see.
categories.f_order: Drag and drop to reorder the storefront menu.
categories.f_bilingual: Arabic and English names, each with its own link.
categories.f_slug: Clean links, with a redirect when you rename.
categories.f_hide: Hide a category without deleting its products.
inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: How much you have, how long it lasts, and when to reorder.
inventory.table_hint: Days of stock use the last 30 days of sales.
inventory.f_variants: Stock per size and colour, not just per product.
inventory.f_cover: Days of stock from your real sales pace.
inventory.f_alert: Your AI COO warns you before a best-seller runs out.
inventory.f_adjust: Count, receive and adjust stock with a reason.
returns.title: Returns
returns.subtitle: Requests from shoppers, what came back, and what was refunded.
returns.f_request: Shoppers request a return from their order page.
returns.f_restock: Received items go back into stock automatically.
returns.f_refund: Refund to card or wallet, or as store credit.
returns.f_ledger: Every refund reverses the sale in your books.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Who visits, where they come from, and what they buy. Revenue comes from your books.
analytics.chart_label: Daily sales for the last 14 days, rising towards today. Total {total} EGP.
analytics.demand_hint: Ranked by purchases, with products people want but can't get.
marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.subtitle: What you spend to bring shoppers in, what it earns, and the tools on your store.
marketing.pixels_hint: Paste an ID; they load only after the shopper accepts cookies.
marketing.tools_hint: Small tools that turn visitors into buyers.
marketing.tool_welcome_hint: A first-order code for new visitors.
marketing.tool_whatsapp_hint: Chat with you from any page.
campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Your Meta campaigns, judged by the orders they really brought to your store.
campaigns.list_hint: Last 7 days. Sales are matched to your orders, not Meta's estimate.
campaigns.f_connect: Read-only link to your Meta ad account.
campaigns.f_match: Orders matched to campaigns through UTM tags and event IDs.
campaigns.f_verdict: A verdict for each campaign, with the reason in plain words.
campaigns.f_propose: New campaign ideas from what shoppers view but don't buy.
campaigns.f_approve: Proposals wait for you; you launch them in Ads Manager.
discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.subtitle: Codes shoppers type at checkout.
discounts.f_types: Percentage, fixed amount or free shipping.
discounts.f_limits: Minimum order, expiry date and usage limit.
discounts.f_margin: The AI never proposes a discount below your margin.
abandoned.title: Abandoned checkouts
abandoned.subtitle: Shoppers who gave their phone but didn't finish. One message often brings them back.
seo.title: SEO
seo.subtitle: How easily Google and AI search find your store, and what to fix first.
seo.issues_hint: Most important first. Your AI CTO drafts the fixes for you to approve.
seo.files_hint: Generated for every store and kept up to date.
seo.search_console_hint: See the searches that bring shoppers to you.
seo.search_console_body: Verify your store once; we import top queries daily.
builder.title: Store builder
builder.subtitle: Pages made of sections. Edit them yourself or describe what you want to your AI team.
builder.later: The builder is planned for a later phase. This is the layout it will use, with sample pages.
builder.f_sections: Hero, product grids, banners, reviews, FAQ and more.
builder.f_edit: Add, hide, reorder and edit sections with a live preview.
builder.f_chat: Describe your business; the Store Builder drafts pages and products.
builder.f_draft: AI changes arrive as drafts; nothing goes live until you approve.
builder.f_versions: Every publish is a version you can restore.
theme.title: Theme
theme.subtitle: Colours, fonts and shapes for your storefront.
theme.shape_hint: Square, soft or round buttons and cards.
media.title: Media
media.subtitle: Every image and video in your store, in one place.
media.library_hint: Images are resized and converted to WebP automatically.
finance.title: Finance
finance.subtitle: Profit, cash and what’s coming, straight from your books.
finance.pl_hint: Revenue less every cost, for the selected period.
finance.forecast_hint: Next three months, from your recent cash flow and bills due.
finance.breakeven_body: You cover all costs at about {amount} of sales a month.
reports.title: Financial statements
reports.subtitle: Profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow, trial balance and VAT for any period.
expenses.title: Expenses and bills
expenses.subtitle: Record what the store spends. Each one posts to the ledger.
expenses.close_hint: A closed month can't change, only be reversed.
budgets.title: Budgets and planning
budgets.subtitle: Set a plan per month, compare it with actuals and try what-ifs on real numbers.
budgets.whatif_hint: Try a price change on this month.
budgets.whatif_note: A guide, not a promise: price changes usually move orders too.
ledger.title: General ledger
ledger.subtitle: Every entry in your books, always balanced.
ledger.journal_hint: Orders, expenses and manual entries, newest first. Open one to see its lines.
settings.subtitle: Your store's name, language and who can see it.
a11y.title: Accessibility and display
a11y.subtitle: Make Minivora easier to read and calmer to use. Changes apply right away.
a11y.text_size_hint: Text, buttons and spacing grow together.
a11y.comfort_hint: These also turn on by themselves when your device asks for them.
a11y.motion_hint: Stop drifting backgrounds, smooth scrolling and page animations.
a11y.transparency_hint: Solid cards instead of frosted glass, and no glowing background.
a11y.contrast_hint: Darker secondary text and visible borders.
a11y.links_hint: So links don't rely on colour alone.
a11y.language_hint: Arabic or English, saved on your account.
payments.title: Payments
payments.subtitle: How shoppers pay you. Gateways run in test mode in version 1.0.
payments.methods_hint: Shoppers see the ones you turn on, in this order.
payments.m_kashier_hint: Visa, Mastercard, Meeza and mobile wallets.
payments.m_instapay_hint: Shopper uploads the receipt; you confirm it.
payments.m_fawry_hint: Pay with a reference code at any Fawry outlet.
payments.safety_body: Card details never touch Minivora. Every payment notice is checked by signature and counted once.
shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.subtitle: Fees and delivery times per governorate.
domain.title: Domain
domain.subtitle: Where shoppers find your store.
domain.custom_hint: HTTPS is set up for you; www and non-www point to one address.
domain.step1: Add a CNAME record at your domain provider.
domain.step2: We check it and issue a certificate.
domain.step3: Your store moves to the new address; old links redirect.
notify.title: Notifications
notify.subtitle: What you're told about, where, and when to stay quiet.
notify.quiet_hint: Urgent alerts, like a payment gateway going down, still come through.
visitors.sources_soon: Traffic sources shown here once tracking starts
fin.cash_chart_label: Cash at the end of each month, recorded and forecast
finance.alert_low_cash_body: At the current pace, cash drops below your safety level of {amount} in {month}.
finance.alert_overdue_bills_body: {count} bills worth {amount} are past their due date.
finance.alert_unsynced_body: {count} paid or shipped orders aren’t posted yet. Catch up from Month close.
finance.alert_close_month_body: {month} is still open. Closing it locks its numbers.
finance.alert_payout_body: {amount} sits with your payment gateway. Record the payout when it reaches the bank.
finance.alert_vat_body: Net VAT payable for {month}: {amount}. File and pay it with the Tax Authority.
finance.empty_body: Paid and shipped orders post themselves. Bring in earlier orders, add your first expense, or enter opening balances such as the money you started with.
finance.trend_hint: Hover or tab through a month to see its profit.
finance.no_costs: No costs in this period yet.
finance.forecast_method: Expected monthly cash flow {flow} (exponential smoothing of recent months, α = 0.5).
finance.runway: At this pace, cash lasts about {months} months.
finance.breakeven_hint: Sales you need each month to cover every cost.
finance.breakeven_none: Not enough sales and costs yet to work out break-even.
finance.orders_needed: That’s about {count} orders at your average of {aov}.
reports.vat_not_registered: Your store isn’t marked as VAT-registered, so sales carry no VAT. Registration is required once taxable sales pass EGP 500,000 a year; change it in Ledger › Settings.
reports.note_pl: Revenue is recognised when money is received: online and InstaPay payments when captured, cash on delivery when collected. Click any account to see its entries.
reports.note_balance: Assets always equal liabilities plus equity. Profit to date is everything earned since your books began.
reports.note_cash: Direct method: every movement in cash, bank and payment-gateway accounts, grouped by what it was for.
reports.note_trial: Every account’s balance. Debits must equal credits.
reports.note_vat: Prepared from posted sales, refunds and expenses. Payments to the Tax Authority are recorded as manual entries and are left out. Confirm filing rules and deadlines with the Egyptian Tax Authority or your accountant.
expenses.void_confirm: Void this expense? Its ledger entries will be reversed.
expenses.empty_body: Add rent, salaries, packaging, courier invoices or ads to see your real profit.
expenses.how_1: Paid now: the category goes up and cash, bank or card goes down.
expenses.how_2: Pay later: it becomes a bill you owe until you mark it paid.
expenses.how_3: VAT on a receipt is kept apart so it can be deducted from VAT on sales.
expenses.new_hint: Enter the total on the receipt.
close.title: Month close
close.subtitle: Check the month, then lock it so its numbers never change.
close.checklist_hint: Red items must be fixed; amber ones are worth a look.
close.check_orders_ok: Every paid and shipped order is posted.
close.check_balanced_blocker: Debits and credits differ. Contact support.
close.check_bank_confirm: Compare your bank statement’s closing balance with the Bank account in the ledger.
close.check_inventory_ok: Stock on hand at cost equals inventory in the books.
close.check_inventory_warning: Stock at cost differs from the books by {amount}. {missing} products have no cost.
close.check_bills_ok: No bills were due this month.
close.check_bills_warning: {count} bills due by month end are unpaid.
close.inventory_confirm: Post an adjustment so inventory in the books equals stock on hand at cost?
close.confirm_bank: I’ve matched the bank statement for this month
close.cannot_yet: Fix the red items first. Only finished months can be closed.
close.reopen_confirm: Reopen this month? Entries can be dated in it again.
close.why_body: Closing freezes the month’s figures, so reports you’ve shared or filed never change. Late refunds land in the next open month instead.
ledger.reverse_confirm: Reverse this entry? A mirror entry is posted; the original stays for the record.
ledger.activity_hint: Every line on this account with a running balance.
ledger.new_entry_hint: For things that aren’t orders or expenses: money you put in, loans, equipment, depreciation, corrections.
ledger.examples: Examples: capital paid into the bank → debit Bank, credit Owner’s capital. Buying a laptop → debit Equipment, credit Bank.
ledger.transfer_hint: Money moving between your own accounts, like a gateway payout reaching the bank or depositing cash.
ledger.fee_hint: If less arrived than was sent
ledger.add_account_hint: The code’s first digit sets the type: 1 assets, 2 liabilities, 3 equity, 4 revenue, 5–6 expenses.
ledger.behaviour_hint: Variable costs grow with each order; used for break-even.
ledger.type_hint_asset: What the store owns: money, stock, equipment.
ledger.type_hint_liability: What the store owes: suppliers, VAT, loans.
ledger.type_hint_equity: The owner’s stake: capital and profit kept.
ledger.type_hint_revenue: Money earned from sales, less discounts and returns.
ledger.type_hint_expense: What it costs to run the store.
ledger.settings_hint: These shape how sales, fees and forecasts are calculated. Changes apply to new entries.
ledger.vat_registered: My store is registered for VAT
ledger.vat_hint: Prices are treated as VAT-inclusive and VAT is carved out of each sale. Registration is required once taxable sales pass EGP 500,000 in 12 months; the standard rate is 14%.
ledger.gateway_hint: From your Kashier or Paymob contract
ledger.safety_hint: You’re warned if the forecast drops below this
budgets.month_running: This month is still running: each plan is scaled to the {pct}% of the month gone, so you can see if you’re on pace.
budgets.no_budget: No budget for this month yet. Fill it from last month or type amounts below.
budgets.whatif_empty: Once a month has sales, try price and cost changes here.
budgets.breakeven_hint: From the average of the last {months} month(s).
budgets.variable_ratio: Variable costs per EGP of sales
budgets.breakeven_formula: Break-even = fixed costs ÷ (1 − variable cost ratio).
budgets.price_hint: The price that keeps your target margin after product cost.
budgets.price_enter: Enter a cost and a margin under 100%.
a11y.effects_hint: Light keeps the same look but stands still: no drifting background, parallax or smooth scrolling. Faster on older computers and phones.
a11y.effects_auto_light: This device looks low-powered, so light effects are on.
a11y.effects_auto_full: Full effects on this device. Motion pauses by itself when you stop using the page.
